title: Writing and balancing simple chemical equation
competency: Write a chemical equation from a word equation.

keywords.def: A shorthand expression of a chemical reaction through symbols and formulas.

en.text: A chemical equation shows a reaction with symbols and formulas. Step 1: write a word equation. Step 2: write the formula of each reactant and product. Step 3: balance it. Hydrogen + oxygen → water becomes H₂ + O₂ → H₂O, then 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O.

screens.title: Short hand
screens.ask: Which is shorter to write: "hydrogen and oxygen produce water" or "2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O"?
screens.after: Chemists write reactions with symbols and formulas. This is a chemical equation.

screens.title: 3.3.5 Writing a chemical equation
paras: A chemical equation is a short hand of a chemical reaction.

screens.title: Example: making water
steps: Step 1, word equation: hydrogen + oxygen → water.
Step 2, formulas: H₂ + O₂ → H₂O. (Hydrogen and oxygen are diatomic.)
Count O: 2 on the left, 1 on the right. Put 2 before H₂O.
Now H: 4 on the right. Put 2 before H₂.

screens.title: Key words
defs: A shorthand expression of a chemical reaction through symbols and formulas.

screens.text: What is the first step in writing a chemical equation?

screens.title: Put the steps in order
items: Write the formula of each substance
screens.why: These are the three steps in order.

screens.text: Hydrogen + oxygen → water. Which line has the correct formulas (before balancing)?
screens.why: Hydrogen and oxygen are diatomic: H₂ and O₂.

screens.text: Why does 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O have a 2 before H₂O?
opts: To make 2 oxygen atoms on the right
screens.ans: To make 2 oxygen atoms on the right
screens.why: O₂ gives 2 O on the left. 2H₂O gives 2 O on the right. Coefficients balance atoms.
screens.clue: Count the oxygen atoms on each side.

Magnesium + oxygen → magnesium oxide. Which formulas are right?
test.why: Oxygen is O₂; magnesium oxide is MgO (2 and 2 simplify).
